lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hello again! Today's story is all about <color=red>dinosaurs</color>, my favourite topic in the whole world.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Read <color=red>carefully</color>, then answer four questions. Get them all right and four new books will land on the library shelves!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Priya loved hunting for <color=red>fossils</color> on the beach near her grandad's cottage.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: One windy morning, just after a storm, she spotted something <color=red>curved</color> poking out of the cliff. It was a huge tooth, as long as her hand!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: She took it to the town museum, where an <color=red>expert</color> explained that it once belonged to a dinosaur that lived millions of years ago.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: The museum put the tooth in a glass case with a little card underneath: <color=red>Discovered</color> by Priya, aged nine.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 1: Where did Priya like to hunt for fossils?
choices: On the beach near her grandad's cottage
lines.hint: Not quite. Look back at the very first part of the story!
lines.correctText: Correct! She searched the beach near her grandad's cottage.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 2: What had happened just before Priya found the tooth?
lines.hint: Not quite. It was a windy morning, remember?
lines.correctText: Yes! She found it just after a storm.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 3: Who told Priya that the tooth came from a dinosaur?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about where she took the tooth.
lines.correctText: Right! The museum expert explained it.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 4: In the story, what does <color=red>discovered</color> mean?
lines.hint: Not quite. Priya was the one who spotted it in the cliff!
lines.correctText: Exactly! Priya was the first to find it.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Four out of four! You'd make a brilliant <color=red>detective</color>. Four new books are heading to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: Thanks for reading with me! I've heard the library now has a whole shelf about <color=red>prehistoric</color> creatures.
